[[File:Proxy-concept-en.svg|thumbnail|]]
In [[applied computing]], a '''proxy''' relays [[network traffic]] between [[requester]] and destination [[server]], which may

* Encrypt the traffic,
* Perform validation/authentification of requester/server
* Scan and filter content,
* Mask requester/server details to server/requester
